description: Conformal-mapped Borel-Pade of the 4_1 Ohtsuki ladder: stabilize the instanton-action (Borel singularity) extraction that raw Borel-Pade loses to Froissart/branch-cut pole scatter; phase-resolve the f-map Stokes datum (audit item C1).
tier: structural-exact (kappa_1..kappa_4 closed forms) + numerical (conformal dlog-Borel-Pade singularity, order-limited)

assertions.name: kappa_1_4_exact_match_witness
assertions.source: closed forms (11/108)sqrt3 pi, (2/27)pi^2, (1081/21870)sqrt3 pi^3, (98/729)pi^4 vs the 20-digit witness strings of qbeta-even-borel-singularity (tolerance at the reference-string precision, not the 50-dps floor).

assertions.name: baseline_froissart_instability_observed
assertions.source: relative spread (max-min)/mean of the nearest-pole modulus across [L/M] — documents the predecessor's raw Borel-Pade instability at 6 rungs (0.28 vs 1.52).

assertions.name: conformal_dlog_iteration_converged
assertions.source: damped fixed-point iteration (tol 1e-11 rel) of the conformal+dlog singularity estimate from trial A0=0.6177, margins mu in {1.5, 2.0}.

assertions.name: conformal_A_stable_across_orders
assertions.source: relative spread of the conformal+dlog fixed-point A across Pade orders / truncations (5-6 rungs) and margins — the C1 stabilization claim (vs 1.51 raw).

assertions.name: action_phase_consistent_with_real
assertions.source: max |arg zeta*| over headline configs; Pringsheim (positive b_n) + amphichirality (CS(4_1)=0) both demand a real-positive action — this supplies the phase resolution the predecessor's Richardson ratio could not.

parameters.borel_normalization: B(zeta) = 1 + sum kappa_n zeta^n / n!, x = 1/N variable (predecessor convention; /2pi for the 2pi/N variable)
parameters.conformal_map: zeta = 4*A0*w/(1+w)^2 (uniformizes the cut [A0, +inf) onto |w|<1); A0 = mu*A_est held above the estimate, mu in {1.5, 2.0}
parameters.truncation_note: mapped d_k depends only on kappa_1..kappa_k, so [L/M] uses exactly rungs 1..L+M (dlog: ..L+M+1) — the truncation axis and the Pade-order axis coincide

result.verdict: C1 CONFORMAL STABILIZATION (scope-(a), order-limited to 6 rungs): raw Borel-Pade of the 4_1 ladder is confirmed unstable at 6 rungs (nearest-pole rel spread 1.51); the conformal-mapped Borel plane (zeta = 4*A0*w/(1+w)^2, margin-held trial, damped fixed-point from A0 = 0.6177) with DLOG-Pade in w stabilizes the singularity at A = 0.65683953 (range [0.63377139, 0.68333979], rel spread 0.0755, branch exponent alpha ~ 0.246) across Pade orders (= truncations 5/6 rungs) and margins. Phase: max |arg| = 0.0 rad — REAL-positive action, as forced by Pringsheim (positive b_n) and amphichirality (CS(4_1)=0). A = 0.65683953 in [0.63377139, 0.68333979]: Vol(4_1)/pi lie(s) WITHIN the spread — consistent-within-spread (order-limited, 6 rungs; NOT an exact identification claim; scope-(a)). The sibling ratio-fit 0.6177 and 2/e (predecessor's closest) fall OUTSIDE the band; the plain-conformal variant's residual downward drift (~0.79->~0.68) is Pade-on-branch-cut bias, removed by dlog. No fit wired anywhere; no c_k value; no tier change. A is in the 1/N normalization (divide by 2*pi for the 2*pi/N variable).
